interface.longDescription:
Datacircle is a data co-op. Query your favorite B2B data APIs through us. Same request, same price, no markup. Every morning, you get the flat file of your data plus everyone else's.

Give Codex a LinkedIn profile URL and it fetches the person's profile (name, headline, location, current company and title, positions, education, skills) from your Datacircle balance. Right now we have 2 live LinkedIn profile APIs that we trust: Up2Data and HarvestAPI. Each request goes to the provider and gets the profile as it is today. Every answer says what the call cost and what's left.

It can also check your balance, list your Datacircle files and give you a download link for them: the free 10M+ U.S. B2B leads dataset for everyone, the 50M+ dataset and the daily co-op files once unlocked.

You need a Datacircle account: sign in with your work email when you connect. A new account starts with a $5 credit.
defaultPrompt: Look up https://www.linkedin.com/in/williamhgates with Datacircle and summarise his career.
